title: Zhejiang Ugoo Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Zhejiang Ugoo Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel manufacturer based in Yiwu, Zhejiang, focused on super-insulation materials and aerogel composite products. The company publicly identifies itself as an aerogel R&D and manufacturing base serving transportation, petrochemical, municipal heating, buildings, LNG, aerospace, and new-energy vehicle applications.

Company Overview

Ugoo positions itself as a cost-effective provider of aerogel super-insulation solutions with broad downstream coverage. Its public site highlights large-scale production, a wide application portfolio, and recent third-party quality and laboratory recognitions.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with industrial and transportation application coverage and outward-facing business development.
  • Focus Areas: New-energy vehicles, aerospace, high-speed rail, petrochemical insulation, municipal heating, industrial furnaces, building insulation, LNG storage and transport, and solar thermal applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel composite insulation materials
  • Aerogel blankets and boards
  • Battery-related thermal insulation products
  • Public Capacity: The company publicly states annual output capacity of 4 million sqm of aerogel composite materials.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Yiwu, Zhejiang, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages reference CNAS laboratory recognition and provincial specialized-enterprise recognitions; detailed international certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: http://www.ugootec.com/

Zhejiang Ugoo Technology Co., Ltd. publicly offers Aerogel Insulation Blanket, Aerogel Board & Panel, Battery Thermal Pad / Cell-to-Cell Barrier, Aerogel Composite Materials.
